claims.statement: CLAUDE.md describes an Excel-driven Robot Framework test repository.
The generator imports pandas and reads config, case, and keyword sheets.
The generator writes Robot files and clears existing files from each selected RBT directory.
The generator defaults to case_debug and converts API and UI suites to RBT files.
The generator imports pandas at module loading.
The MCP server registers keyword lookup, skeleton generation, statistics, refresh, and example tools.
The MCP entrypoint builds its index before starting the STDIO transport.
The scanner loads local Python libraries and installed libraries through LibraryDocumentation.
The scanner parses Robot resources through robot.api.get_model.
The project manifest requires Python 3.13 and lists pinned Robot and Browser dependencies.
Install requirements and the project manifest declare different Robot and Browser versions.
claims.reason: Install requirements declare Robot 7.5 and Browser 18.6.3; the manifest declares Robot 7.2.2 and Browser 19.1.2.

claims.statement: The project manifest does not declare pandas or fastmcp directly.
API imports require ENV and SECRET substitutions, private environment settings, and CryptoLibrary keys.
UI imports load environment settings, certificates, and CryptoLibrary keys.
PostgreSQL helpers refresh RATAN credentials and execute caller-supplied SQL.
The MySQL helper connects through configuration variables and queries caller-supplied SQL.
Credential refresh uses certificate files, HashiCorp login, and a credential endpoint under environment guards.
Kafka helpers create a producer from KAFKA_HOSTS and KAFKA_PORT, produce a message, and flush.
The Kafka HTTP helper posts messages to a topic data endpoint under KAFKA_API_URL.
Service discovery queries Eureka and selects health URLs using ENV and forceDev.
A conversion helper discovers a service URL and posts a caller-supplied payload.
Ratan Login posts configuration credentials and extracts Single-UI-Authorization from the response.
GET RATAN TOKEN invokes Ratan Login and saves each returned token as a global variable.
The gRPC helper invokes grpcurl with token headers, a proto file, and the insecure transport option.
The MinIO uploader writes files through fput_object.
The MinIO module calls main at module scope.
The directory uploader recursively calls upload_to_minio for selected files.
GenResults.close generates local result JSON; its MinIO upload call is commented.
RunListener.close generates local result JSON; its MinIO upload call is commented.
The ADO uploader posts case and result payloads with TLS verification disabled.
Browser helpers create a browser context with ignored HTTPS errors and open a supplied URL.
One inspected country suite generates a cashflow and asserts two returned city values.
An inspected gRPC helper contains a literal authorization value.
The Dockerfile uses a private Python 3.10 image and installs pandas separately.
Canonical implementation and integration approval owners remain unknown.
claims.reason: Documentation names a team but does not establish current approval authority or catalog ownership.
